decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a high-fidelity speaker that serves as a bridge between a premium indoor smart-speaker and a rugged outdoor portable device. The Sonos One (prod_034) and Sony SRS-RA3000 (prod_144) offer excellent indoor sound and smart features but lack the battery power and waterproofing needed for travel. Conversely, the JBL Charge 5 (prod_120) and Sony XB43 (prod_181) are outstanding outdoor speakers but are directional and lack the specific 360-degree immersive sound profile I desire for home use. The JBL Clip 3 (prod_147) is excellent for portability but doesn't meet the audio fidelity requirements for a primary speaker. Since no single option perfectly satisfies the requirement for a high-end, 360-degree, smart-enabled hybrid speaker, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
